a.text: The 6th Army appears to have been reformed in 2010.

b.text: The army was reformed as part of the creation of the Western Military District / Western Operational-Strategic Command.

a.text: The 6th Army besieged Fortress Breslau in the Battle of Breslau.
The 6th Army besieged Fortress Breslau in the Battle of Breslau.

b.text: The encirclement of Breslau was completed.

a.text: The 338th Guards Tank Regiment was reduced and renamed 82nd independent Tank Battalion.

b.text: The tank regiment was reduced to a battalion.

a.text: The 16th Motor Rifle Division became the 5186th Base for Storage of Weapons and Equipment.

b.text: The 37th similarly became a weapons and equipment storage base (VKhVT).
